report:
Trouvailles:

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité. 

Il y a une déchirure complète du ligament croisé antérieur près de son insertion fémorale. Le croisé postérieur est intact.

Il y a un amincissement et fissure partielle du cartilage de la facette médiale et de l'apex de la rotule. Il y a un léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du cartilage du compartiment interne. Il n'y a pas de région de perte de cartilage complet. 

Autrement, le ménisque interne, le ménisque externe, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps femoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion:

1- Déchirure complète du ligament croisé antérieur. 

2- Légers changements dégénératifs du compartiment interne et patello-fémoral.

3- Petit épachement sans kyste poplité.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 3 month history of inner knee pain after kneeling. Clinical concern for medial meniscus tear.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: High grade partial-thickness cartilage loss in the weightbearing medial femoral condyle with subchondral bone marrow edema.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Partial thickness fissuring lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Cartilage heterogeneity with full-thickness fissuring along the medial patellar facet with subchondral bone marrow edema and at the central trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Grade 1 sprain pattern.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Tricompartmental chondrosis moderate in the medial compartment with a moderate joint effusion. No meniscal tear.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 6 months of knee pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the medial meniscus with a predominant oblique radial tear at the posterior root with additional tearing of the medial meniscus body with severe extrusion into the meniscotibial gutter. Reactive edema along the medial joint line.
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade cartilage loss along the periphery of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 4 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complex tear of the medial meniscus with a predominant oblique radial tear at the posterior root with additional tearing of the medial meniscus body with severe extrusion into the meniscotibial gutter. Reactive edema along the medial joint line.
2.	Medical compartment chondrosis.

There is a complex degenerative tear through the posterior horn and root of the medial meniscus, with a predominantly radial component, with consequent significant medial extrusion at the level of the body.
There are no accompanying displaced meniscal fragment.

A small subarticular, horizontally oriented fracture line is noted at the medial tibial plateau, with accompanying surrounding marrow oedema like signal change but with no associated articular surface collapse being demonstrated. 
Diffuse grade 2/3 medial weightbearing articular cartilage damage, there is furthermore a moderate suprapatellar effusion that is communicating with a leaking, 5 cm maximal diameter Baker's cyst.

Grossly intact lateral meniscus, cruciate and lateral collateral ligaments, a grade 1 superficial MCL sprain is present.
Normal popliteus musculotendinous unit, extensor tendons and the distal iliotibial band.

No other skeletal abnormality of note, minor, focal medial retropatellar articular cartilage damage.
Well-maintained remaining patellofemoral and lateral weightbearing articular cartilage surfaces.

Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Impression:
Unstable complex medial meniscal tear as detailed above, along with insufficiency type bony injury at the medial tibial plateau.
Temporary nonweightbearing advisable in the first instance, together with screening for possible underlying risk factors.

Findings:  Small suprapatellar knee joint effusion. No sinister bone marrow changes. Small 10 mm x 3 mm intra-articular retropatellar soft tissue focus.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments.  Intact medial meniscus. Horizontal tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus which breaches the inferior meniscal surface. Radial fraying of the inner free edge of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus.  Normal appearance of the pes anserine tendons, popliteus tendon, distal biceps femoris tendon and distal iliotibial band.  Intact extensor mechanism. No evidence of fat pad impingement.  Minor fibrillation of the hyaline articular cartilage in the lateral tibiofemoral compartment. Otherwise well maintained tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage.  
Conclusion:  Horizontal tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus which breaches the inferior meniscal surface. Radial fraying of the inner free edge of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus. Small 10 mm x 3 mm intra-articular retropatellar soft tissue focus. Possibly represents a small focus of PVNS - patient will be recalled for dedicated sequences.
Exam performed: MR Recall of [DATE]:  Findings:  The previously described small intra-articular retropatellar soft tissue focus cannot be readily appreciated on the current scan. There are no intra-articular soft tissue foci which demonstrate blooming artefact to suggest PVNS.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial ve lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.  Medial menisküs mediale doğru ekstrude görünümdedir. Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde periligamentöz ödem ve sinyal artışı izlenmiştir ( grade I-II sprain ).Ön ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir.Suprapatellar bursada ve diz eklemi içerisinde sıvı artışı ve sinoviumda kalınlaşma izlenmiştir ( bursit-snovit ). Patellar tendon normal izlendi. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinakulumlar normal.Patellar kıkırdak lateral fasette kıkırdakta bütünlük kaybı ve komşu kemikte subkondrial kemik iliği ödemi mevcuttur ( grade IV kondromalazi ).Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda hafif osteofitik sivrileşmeler tibiofemoral eklem aralığında medialde  daralma ve komşu kartilajlarda incelmeler izlendi(dejeneratif artrit bulguları).Popliteal fossada 55x18 mm boyutlarında baker kisti izlendi.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Síndrome de banda iliotibial.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de una rotura en estas
secuencias.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras
condrales de espesor parcial de la faceta medial de la rótula.
No hay derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Discreto aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales. Mínimo edema las partes blandas entre la banda de tibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Mínimos fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Irregularitäten des Knorpels femorotibial, teils höhergradig (Serie 5/ Image 19). Keine vollschichtige Läsion, kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Intakter Innenmeniskus mit allenfalls initialen mukoiden Veränderungen. Flüssigkeit angrenzend an das MCL (Serie 5/ Image 21).

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Geringe Irregularitäten des Knorpels am Patellafirst (Serie 4/ Image 10). Kein tiefgreifender Defekt, kein subchondrales Ödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Patellar- und Quadrizepssehne.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Deutlicher Gelenkerguss mit etwas verdickter Synovia. Regelrechtes flow-void in den erfassten Gelenken.

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS



> Wearing of articular surface and large spur formation of right knee, including femorotibial joint and patellofemoral joint and subchondral edema of medial femorotibial joint and patella, reflecting osteoarthritis.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
> No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
> Interstitial increased signal intensity of ACL and PCL and MCL on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury or degeneration
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Subcutaneous infiltration over right knee.

Impression: 
1. Osteoarthritis of rigth knee, more severe at medial compartment.
2. C/W Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
3. Mild synovitis of right knee and patellar plicae.
4. R/O grade 1 injury of ACL, PCL and MCL.
5. Subcutaneous infiltration over right knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Interprétation:

Minime épanchement intra-articulaire potentiellement d'ordre physiologique. Liséré de liquide au sein du récessus poplité sans kyste de Baker significatif. 

Les ménisques interne et externe sont intacts sans déchirure.

Le ligament collatéral interne est intact sans déchirure. Légère délamination/déchirure partielle longitudinale interstielle de bas grade au tiers distal du tendon commun du tendon du biceps fémoral et du ligament fibulo-collatéral. Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. 

Légère atténuation des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémoral tibial interne principalement, et externe sans atteinte transfixiante ou changements sous-chondraux réactionnels. 

L'alignement patello-fémoral est préservé. Les tendons du quadriceps distal et patellaire sont intacts sans déchirure. Légère fibrillation superficielle des surfaces chondrales au compartiment patello-fémoral sans atteinte transfixiante ou changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés.

Les tendons du quadriceps distal et patellaire sont intacts, sans déchirure. Légère tendinose patellaire.

Il y a une atrophie graisseuse sévère du muscle gastrocnémien interne de nature indéterminée, d'allure chronique. Légère atrophie graisseuse linéaire focale également au sein des muscles gastocnémien externe et soléaire. Ceci pourrait être de nature post-traumatique.

Petit kyste ganglionnaire probable au versant postéro-interne du genou.

Conclusion:

Pas de déchirure méniscale. 

Légère délamination/déchirure partielle longitudinale interstielle de bas grade au tiers distal du tendon commun du tendon du biceps fémoral et du ligament fibulo-collatéral. Pas de déchirure ligamentaire significative ou transfixiante.

Pas d'épanchement intra-articulaire significatif. 

Légère chondropathie tricompartimentale.

Atrophie graisseuse sévère du muscle gastrocnémien interne de nature indéterminée, d'allure chronique. Post-traumatique?
